_comment: P3 第五批切片金标：GET /api/v1/trade-docs/{doc_id}（详情）。同脚本用旧路径真实生成。注意：详情 SQL 没有作用域谓词 —— 可见性是行级纯判定 _require_doc_visible（404 DOC_NOT_FOUND，不泄露存在性）；上游 refs = 列优先 + entity_links 兜底。时间戳同时覆盖零微秒（issued_at）与非零微秒（created_at/updated_at）。

old_sql.sql: SELECT * FROM trade_docs WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2
SELECT dst_type, dst_id, rel_type, meta FROM entity_links WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND src_type='trade_doc' AND src_id=$2 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT 1 FROM trade_docs WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2 AND id>$3 LIMIT 1

trade_docs_total.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM trade_docs WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND doc_type = $2 AND status = $3 AND (team_id = $4 OR owner_id = $5 OR owner_scope = 'tenant')

trade_docs.columns: id, tenant_id, doc_no, doc_type, order_id, customer_id, quote_id, status, currency, total_amount, CASE WHEN to_char(issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS issued_at, issued_by, raw_payload, owner_id, owner_scope, team_id, with_seal, CASE WHEN to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS created_at, CASE WHEN to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS updated_at
trade_docs.sql: SELECT id, tenant_id, doc_no, doc_type, order_id, customer_id, quote_id, status, currency, total_amount, CASE WHEN to_char(issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS issued_at, issued_by, raw_payload, owner_id, owner_scope, team_id, with_seal, CASE WHEN to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS created_at, CASE WHEN to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS updated_at FROM trade_docs WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND doc_type = $2 AND status = $3 AND (team_id = $4 OR owner_id = $5 OR owner_scope = 'tenant') ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $6 OFFSET $7

later_docs.sql: SELECT 1 FROM trade_docs WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2 AND id>$3 LIMIT 1

render_checks.sql: SELECT trade_doc_id, matches, reason, render_version_drift, checked_at FROM trade_doc_render_checks WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND trade_doc_id = ANY($2::bigint[])
